subject: grad
title: GRAD. ------ INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-16, second of three on book p128, paired with v2-p128-1 and v2-p128-3. Continues Braxton's diagnostic of expansion conditions: gradualism considered as a *concept* (the (c) prefix) against information-dynamics. (C)GRAD (the concept of gradualism) is crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics): the question is what gradualism produces when crossed with information-dynamics. CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) branches from the main line and carries two chains: IST-F (isolated focus), which carries CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) and CRT (criticism), and DYM-SEP (dynamic separation), which leads to INT (intention). INFO-DY is the partner. INFO-TRNS (information transference) also branches from the main line and leads to INFO-AF-B (information-affinity basis), then to IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and on to APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions).
